notes.title: Thank you for taking this journey with us
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25249429/4eb71c762044744074a0677156ee24415da769ed.png[/img]

Dear Crushers!

We've had a blast working on Crush Online for such a great community! Unfortunately, we are bringing you some sad news today: The 30th of April 2017 will be our last day for the Steam version. This means Crush Online will be going offline on the 1st of May 2017 on Steam. We would like to thank all of you who took this journey with us! We are working on a new project that will include all our learnings from the past and use the core concept of Crush Online. We know now what elements work well and will use these to make a great game out of it. Thank you and keep gaming!

Payment got deactivated!

Your Crush Online Team

Note: Check our forum for possible refund policies.

http://crush-game.com/forum/

notes.title: Crush Online Comics 2016
notes.notes:
Enjoy our collection of Crush Online Comics 2016! These are taken from our facebook page which you can find here https://www.facebook.com/Crushonlinethegame/?fref=ts
----------------------------------------------------------------

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25249429/00cec4a89c3870ed6073809ba0afd02cd1aa40c0.png[/img]

Level 2016 is almost done! What are you goals for 2017? Let's CRUSH next year! 🎉🎉


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25249429/0a572662096c9db5775f4d3a98281f74bd42ca37.png[/img]

Throwback thursday to our release on 10th October! We are incredibly thankful for every one of you. ❤ The Crush Online Team is super excited to begin the new year with you 💪



[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25249429/78891dfded24a0ee513143b7791a9c2badd83fb6.png[/img]

Merry Christmas to all Crushers! 🎅
Enjoy your festive season! 🎄
How do you celebrate? 🎁



[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25249429/0b466e9848cacaf942e46d8338f60ce9dbb2f9ba.png[/img]

The bigger the challenge - the greater the reward! ☃️



[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25249429/6a0e78e6c5e4a42cb32d571475f1445dcd33c8e0.png[/img]

It's not just candy, it's cookies! 🎅



[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25249429/891bd5bbdc33369c72f3163288d16161dff360d2.png[/img]

Teach a man to fish and you'll feed him for a lifetime. Teach a Punisher how to fish and he'll make sushi!



[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25249429/8c05852914e66790514f3883431db354927a5634.png[/img]

Being a gentleman is not easy, but neither is being a merchant!



[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25249429/2a77ec295cf1a13c39c6be8bf9454c2d61505cbc.png[/img]

Beware the fearsome Chepa Archer and his deadly ... furballs?



[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25249429/71069de10fff1b16957626b95a2b9f0f4db5205d.png[/img]

Not every enemy you meet is what you expect, be careful who you engage!



[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25249429/b413686cd6c60f20e47dd084bcf010c345995af4.png[/img]

This could have been one reason why Erion and Armia started war  :o



[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25249429/89f2360f0e027cdcee6e611576afd4d4a66e7af0.png[/img]

If you can't win the fight, try a different strategy and hope your enemy doesn't know how to use his skills properly! 😄



[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25249429/2128b413ab711a160b01817eb076ce8ee9ec4427.png[/img]

Brace yourselves, Winter is coming! That's no problem for our brave heroes though... or is it? ⛄



[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25249429/ade28a791abc94451eb2d81fe4a4c8c5c689f404.png[/img]

Sometimes you have to improvise in order to succeed. Even if it leads to unconventional methods



[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25249429/d0bb6d02957e4d2c430f45f288749768644a772c.png[/img]

We are ready for #Halloween, so are our heroes! Suit up and go trick or treating 🎃



[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25249429/1d8e79e26553f819c605e5d47365578ed0c3b0ec.png[/img]

Just because you're a saint, doesn't mean you don't know how to fight!



[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25249429/aad92661b1fa461d9245b477fa810f2346b5477b.png[/img]

Hey, I just met you and this is crazy, but here's my arrow, so crush me maybe? 🎶



[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25249429/182e29f2f7ca65f25f0421dcda78c1a111c0a00e.png[/img]

When pushing <Space> is too much effort - the Guardian's Gattling Gun acts as a multi-purpose problem solver!



[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25249429/83f25e0aa66e433020025cca7937cd82363f81f4.png[/img]

When your legion asks for help and you get to the portal like ...



[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25249429/0a3a857b14016f18495a9cea2ffdebfc06e7272e.png[/img]

Spotted: Freya dealing quests on the street! How do you like to level: Questing or Fighting Mobs?



[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25249429/2a4ed3c20e026181f96b0eed2882c36a7808f102.png[/img]

This is what happens when you visit Chepa Village for the first time 🐯



[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25249429/50e1a0b061cce3bbe50bca67534b13ae2170239d.png[/img]

Which fighting style do you prefer: MELEE 👍 or RANGED ❤? In Crush Online you can play both at the same time!



[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25249429/1e46287182d9bd6d03a4bad8221e67742524bdec.png[/img]

Don't we all want someone to look at us like Floyd looks at her Bucket of Slime?



[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25249429/1c114a1177e6b1a73e471b7cd2c65416b4300970.png[/img]

Haley grants you one wish: Expand your territory 👍 or upgrade your fortress ❤! Choose wisely!



[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25249429/7ec4b9b26b6316aaaef551b1aa6db947022b14ae.png[/img]

Did you know that you can salvage gem stones to get various crystals for crafting better artifacts? What have you crafted so far?



[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25249429/29bdc3c32bd5ff5891acfa5ba8455b9507a9381a.png[/img]

Epic war is here! Which nation do you join?



[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25249429/7f8d04e00ed8046075523ff8659d3b2ef71de792.png[/img]

The Open Beta is here!!!!!



[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25249429/d120421ac3fc1a376022831771831c7787b14bb6.png[/img]

This is how we're spending our Summer Holidays - how about you?

Before Holiday Season some bigger changes:

Weapon Balancing 

We changed the Weapon balance in a way that high weapons grade are stronger that lower ones but not that much stronger anymore. This will make it easier for new players.


SP/TP Changes
As bigger the distance from nation fort is as bigger will be the penalty on TPs & SPs in fights. 

VIP
In general: Daily Jewels must be obtained manually.
Basic VIPs can now also receive 5 Jewels.

Civil War

The stake is just a bid to challenge the fort and will not be refund if bid was successful but Civil War was won or lost.

If the challenger wins, he takes over the fort (including cores + taxes, but only if the fort exists on the same channel).

After successful Civil War the player can collect the fort’s taxes until Sunday 24:00 CET. The taxes are collected through purchase, sale & crafting of items in the fort. These are collected as Gold during the week. 

After Civil War the Gold can be received as Legion Ether.
There is no Civil War on Channel 3 anymore.

Blacksmith Farrel & Skillstones

Items can now also be bought and sold at Blacksmith Farrel’s.
All Skillstones for Strikers Rank 1 - 2 can now be bought with Gold & no longer need to be crafted.

All Strikers Rank 3 and higher Skillstones still need to be crafted. 

Land of the Lord Buff 
From now on this Buff can be received through the following conditions:
PvP = opposing Nexus must be destroyed
PvE = Kill Boss in Territory
The Buff is lost through the following conditions:
When fleeing the battlefield
When the battle was lost while fighting


Drop Chance Potion 

The Drop Chance Potion increases the drop chances by 20% for 1 hour.
Now available in the shop for 500 Jewels or in a bundle of 10 for 4.500 Jewels.


Xmas Drop Chance costumes

The Christmas Set costumes have a +10 % drop chance and are durable for 14 days. They are available for 3.800 Jewels in the Auction House. All previous Christmas costumes remain without drop chance & permanent.

Important: The set will be removed from the Auction House on 9th of January 2017 - so hurry up. 


Costume changes

Halloween costumes have been removed from the shop. From now on all costumes in the shop are limited to 14 days. Here are the new prices:

Summer Set - 2.000 Jewels
Dragon Slayer Set - 2.500 Jewels
Athlete Set - 2.000 Jewels
Maid Set - 2.000 Jewels
Military Set - 2.000 Jewels
Goosebam Set - 2.500 Jewels
Christmas Set - 3.800 Jewels

Permanent & invisible costumes 

Costumes can be made permanent by (Merits Costume Merchant) for 10 Million Gold. 

Sothe Costume will be set as permanent basis skin and all effects as well as time limitations will be removed. The costume will be new default skin of your character. 

A set costume can be invincible with the Costume Remover for 425.000 Gold,

Your default skin will be visible but the you will keep the stats of your costume.

We wish you a Merry Christmas & a happy new year


Your,

Crush Online Team

notes.title: Season 1 Start
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25249429/fc4909dd060c6a65e47b5d8040f21a72a9a16a4a.png[/img]

Dear Players,

Here some detailed information about our newest patch which is introducing Season 1:

- The Lord of the Land buff is now also triggered after killing the Boss Monster in PvE.

- The number of channels has been reduced from 5 to 3 to give you more action. 

- Ranks in Crush Online are structured as follows:
1 King
20 Marshalls, but with next Council it will be reduced to 8 Marshalls
3 Imperators, Players which are 1st - 3rd in the individual Ranking
20 Generals, Players which are 4th - 25th in the individual Ranking
50 Officiers, Players which are 25th - 73rd in the individual Ranking

- From now the TP Skills are available for more players.

- The HP potion (Life Saviour) can no longer be used in the battle arena and its cool time is 120 seconds.

- Premium Life Saviour (Bundle of 25 Prime Life Saviour will cost 1000 Jewels in Auction House) : Max Hp 50% Recovery , Recovery value 2000 over case Hp Recovery 2000

- Fame Life Saviour (Merits Merchant 1,000 Fame) : Max Hp 30% Recovery , Recovery value 1000 over case Hp Recovery 10

- The invincibility effect of Invincible Armor and the invisibility effect of Gloves of Ghost now only affect the player wearing the item and the duration has been reduced to 3 seconds.

- If a player holds a tower on their side during war they receive 8 TP points for each tower every 10 seconds.

- Following Auction House Prices have changed in Auction House:

High Reinforcing Adjuvants 2,000 Jewels/10,000.000 Gold
VIP 30 Days 2,500 Jewels/12,500.000 Gold
Constructing Fort 4,500 Jewels/22,500.00

- The chance of monster invasions has been changed and depends mainly on the Safety Factor and secondly on the total amount of conquered territories on a channel.

- The preview function for costumes is now available

Lords of the Land Buff changed
1st Buff : Attack damage and Ability Power +10 (was: +4 %)
2nd Buff : Cooldown and the resurrection waiting time - 5%
3rd Buff : SP gain + 6
4th Buff : Attack damage and Ability Power + 4% (was: Take 5% less damage and deal the same amount as bonus damage.)
5th Buff : Increase heal and Mana Regeneration by 20. Doubles benefits of the whole buff.

Some minor Bug Fixes

Here you can see the full patch notes: http://www.crush-game.com/forum/threads/patch-notes-20161123-season-1.714/

Enjoy the beginning of Season 1 and see you in-game.

Your
Crush Online Team

notes.title: Beginner channel and new Artifacts
notes.notes:
Hello, 

We integrated a new Beginner channel with following conditions: 

New players below Level 25 will be transferred to this Channel, the former Channel 5, after the first time they use a Gaia Scroll. On this channel some special rules apply. 

- Within war only Weapons and Artifacts with Grade D or C can be used 

- Only a small amout of the regular monsters can be found within PvE Wars 

-Legions which have their Fortress on this channel will get a higher amount of Legion Fame while defending this. 

- Only Dungeons up to Level 3 will appear on that channel 

- The use of an Gaia Scroll within a War will bring the player in a safe zone 

As well we added the first new artifacts (3) and made several bugfixes. More information about them you find in the forum.  We are working on more bugfixes and as well new content. 

Your Crush Online Team

notes.title: Buying Jewels via Steam is finally live
notes.notes:
Many of you already asked about it but finally it is done. Right before the weekend we would like to announce that payment via Steam in Crush Online is live . 

If you ask yourself how to top up Jewels here a quick guide: 

- So just login and play Crush Online. 
- Click one of the add Jewels buttons ingame (Shopping Cart, or "+"):
- Press the “Charge” button
- Choose your Jewels package in the store 
- And you will be redirected to the Steam check-out Page where you just have to confirm the purchase of Jewels

Thanks for your patient and enjoy playing Crush Online

Your
Crush Online Team 

P.S. We are working on several things currently like a Beginner channel, a lot bug fixes and an automated permban for cheaters (currently we ban them daily as we detect them more or less all)

notes.title: Launch
notes.notes:
After intensive testing with you we are happy to announce the release of Crush Online. Here an overview what is waiting for you:

Pure PvP Action 

There is war in Gaia and you have to choose between 3 nations for the ultimate victory. Fight against other players to dominate.

3 Unique Classes 

No matter what your playstyle is, in Crush Online you can choose between three classes:

The Punisher - deals a lot of damage with bows and daggers.

The Guardian - is a frontline beast with powerful hammers & cannons.

The Saint - uses deathly magic with her wands, dual guns & flying blades.


Action-oriented Gameplay 

You can choose between multiple weapon setups for the action oriented fights. It relies on your skill and tactics to win the challenging fights against other foes.

Legions, Politics & Kings

The key to success is to work together with other players and establish a powerful Legion. Claim the ranking with your Legion and become the chance to be the King of your nation. You can make strategic decisions and lead your nation to glorious victory.

So you are ready for the war? ​

Last but not Least we are happy for your support and hope you will have a lot of fun playing Crush Online. Watch out the forum as new content will be prepared and announced soon.

Stay tuned and let the war begin


Your

Crush Online Team

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25249429/9c605255ecd116d35c5c1209e21f99239c698f9b.png[/img]
